mapper.select: SELECT fnd26_terms_detail_id AS terms_detail_id , fnd26_revision_date AS revision_date , fnd26_revision_no AS revision_no , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = fnd26_terms_detail_id ) AS file_cnt , fnd26_content AS content FROM fnd25_terms INNER JOIN fnd26_terms_detail ON fnd25_terms_id = fnd26_terms_id WHERE fnd25_terms_id = #{termsId} AND fnd25_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd26_use_yn = 'true' ORDER BY fnd26_revision_no DESC

SELECT fnd25.fnd25_terms_id AS terms_id , fnd25.fnd25_terms_type AS terms_type , f_cdnm('FundTermsType', fnd25.fnd25_terms_type, fnd25.fnd25_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS terms_type_name , fnd26.fnd26_terms_nm AS terms_name , fnd25.fnd25_seq AS seq , fnd25.fnd25_fund_id AS fund_id , fnd01.fnd02_ksd_fund_cd AS ksd_fund_code , fnd01.fnd02_fund_nm AS fund_name , fnd09.fnd09_trust_bank_nm AS trust_bank_name , fnd01.fnd01_start_date AS fund_start_date , fnd26.fnd26_revision_date AS revision_date , fnd26.fnd26_revision_no AS revision_no FROM fnd25_terms fnd25 INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (fnd26_terms_id) fnd26_terms_id , fnd26_terms_detail_id , fnd26_terms_nm , fnd26_content , fnd26_note , fnd26_revision_date , fnd26_revision_no , fnd26_use_yn FROM fnd26_terms_detail WHERE fnd26_use_yn = 'true' ORDER BY fnd26_terms_id , fnd26_revision_no DESC) AS fnd26 ON fnd26.fnd26_terms_id = fnd25.fnd25_terms_id LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM fnd01_fund_code INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info ON ( fnd01_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01_fund_code_id AND fnd02_work_date = f_max_workdate(fnd02_fund_code_id, f_trunc(f_sysdate())) )) fnd01 ON fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd25.fnd25_fund_id LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd09_trust_bank fnd09 ON ( fnd09_trust_bank_cd = fnd01.fnd02_trust_bank_cd AND fnd09_company_id = fnd01.fnd01_company_id ) WHERE fnd25_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd25_terms_type LIKE #{termsType} AND CONCAT(fnd26.fnd26_terms_nm, fnd01.fnd02_fund_nm, fnd01.fnd02_ksd_fund_cd) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY fnd25_seq, fnd25_terms_type, fnd26_terms_nm, fnd26_revision_date

SELECT fnd26_terms_detail_id AS terms_detail_id , fnd25_terms_id AS terms_id , fnd26_terms_nm AS terms_name , fnd25_terms_type AS terms_type , f_cdnm('FundTermsType', fnd25_terms_type, fnd25_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS terms_type_name , fnd25_seq AS seq , fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id AS fund_id , fnd01.fnd02_ksd_fund_cd AS ksd_fund_code , fnd26_revision_date AS revision_date , fnd26_revision_no AS revision_no , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = fnd26_terms_detail_id ) AS file_cnt , (fnd26_use_yn = 'true') AS use_yn , fnd25_close_date AS close_date , fnd26_content AS content , fnd26_note AS note , fnd26_upd_nm AS upd_name , COALESCE(TO_CHAR(fnd26_upd_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), ''::text) AS upd_date_str FROM fnd26_terms_detail INNER JOIN fnd25_terms ON fnd25_terms_id = fnd26_terms_id LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM fnd01_fund_code INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info ON ( fnd01_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01_fund_code_id AND fnd02_work_date = f_max_workdate(fnd02_fund_code_id, f_trunc(f_sysdate())) )) fnd01 ON fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd25_fund_id WHERE fnd25_terms_id = #{termsId} AND fnd25_company_id = #{companyId} AND CONCAT(fnd26_terms_nm, fnd26_note) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY fnd26_revision_no DESC

SELECT fnd25.fnd25_terms_id AS terms_id , f_cdnm('FundTermsType', fnd25_terms_type, fnd25_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS terms_type_name , fnd26.fnd26_terms_nm AS terms_name , fnd01.fnd02_ksd_fund_cd AS ksd_fund_code , fnd01.fnd02_fund_nm AS fund_name , fnd09.fnd09_trust_bank_nm AS trust_bank_name , fnd01.fnd01_start_date AS fund_start_date , f_cdnm('IcamFundType', fnd01.fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd, fnd01.fnd01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS kofia_fund_type_name , fnd26.fnd26_revision_date AS revision_date , fnd26.fnd26_revision_no AS revision_no , fnd01.fnd02_end_expect_date AS end_expect_date FROM fnd25_terms fnd25 INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (fnd26_terms_id) fnd26_terms_id , fnd26_terms_detail_id , fnd26_terms_nm , fnd26_content , fnd26_note , fnd26_revision_date , fnd26_revision_no , fnd26_use_yn FROM fnd26_terms_detail WHERE fnd26_use_yn = 'true' ORDER BY fnd26_terms_id , fnd26_revision_no DESC) AS fnd26 ON fnd26.fnd26_terms_id = fnd25.fnd25_terms_id LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM fnd01_fund_code INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info ON ( fnd01_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01_fund_code_id AND fnd02_work_date = f_max_workdate(fnd02_fund_code_id, f_trunc(f_sysdate())) )) fnd01 ON fnd01.fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd25.fnd25_fund_id LEFT OUTER JOIN fnd09_trust_bank fnd09 ON ( fnd09_trust_bank_cd = fnd01.fnd02_trust_bank_cd AND fnd09_company_id = fnd01.fnd01_company_id ) WHERE fnd25_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd25_terms_type LIKE #{termsType} AND CONCAT(fnd26.fnd26_terms_nm) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY fnd25_seq, fnd26.fnd26_terms_nm, fnd25_terms_type, fnd26.fnd26_revision_date

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fnd25_terms (fnd25_terms_id, fnd25_company_id, fnd25_terms_type, fnd25_seq, fnd25_close_date, fnd25_fund_id, fnd25_upd_nm, fnd25_upd_date) VALUES (#{termsId}, #{companyId}, #{req.termsType}, #{req.seq}, #{req.closeDate}, #{req.fundId}, #{userName}, now())
mapper.update: UPDATE fnd25_terms SET fnd25_terms_type = #{req.termsType}, fnd25_seq = #{req.seq}, fnd25_close_date = #{req.closeDate}, fnd25_fund_id = #{req.fundId}, fnd25_upd_nm = #{userName}, fnd25_upd_date = now() WHERE fnd25_terms_id = #{termsId} AND fnd25_company_id = #{companyId}

UPDATE fnd25_terms SET fnd25_terms_type = #{req.termsType}, fnd25_seq = #{req.seq}, fnd25_close_date = #{req.closeDate}, fnd25_fund_id = #{req.fundId}, fnd25_upd_nm = #{userName}, fnd25_upd_date = now() WHERE fnd25_terms_id = #{termsId} AND fnd25_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fnd26_terms_detail (fnd26_terms_detail_id, fnd26_terms_id, fnd26_terms_nm, fnd26_content, fnd26_note, fnd26_revision_date, fnd26_revision_no, fnd26_use_yn, fnd26_upd_nm, fnd26_upd_date) VALUES (#{termsDetailId}, #{termsId}, #{req.termsName}, #{req.content}, #{req.note}, #{req.revisionDate}, #{req.revisionNo}, CASE WHEN #{req.useYn} THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END, #{userName}, now())
mapper.update: UPDATE fnd26_terms_detail SET fnd26_terms_id = #{termsId}, fnd26_terms_nm = #{req.termsName}, fnd26_content = #{req.content}, fnd26_note = #{req.note}, fnd26_revision_date = #{req.revisionDate}, fnd26_revision_no = #{req.revisionNo}, fnd26_use_yn = CASE WHEN #{req.useYn} THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END, fnd26_upd_nm = #{userName}, fnd26_upd_date = now() WHERE fnd26_terms_detail_id = #{termsDetailId} AND fnd26_terms_id IN (SELECT fnd25_terms_id FROM fnd25_terms WHERE fnd25_company_id = #{companyId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fnd26_terms_detail WHERE fnd26_terms_id IN (SELECT fnd25_terms_id FROM fnd25_terms WHERE fnd25_company_id = #{companyId}) AND fnd26_terms_detail_id IN #{termsDetailId}
